text: From the Windows clone, working your request 20261005T102745Z-air-dc5d27: the POSIX emulation helper in tests/test_write_guard.py calls the host's realpath, so macOS symlinks leak in; this lane makes it answer lexically. Also filing DEF-1130 in the C0 section (the windows-latest spawn-worker start-up stall, red in every Windows portability run since #86). DEF-1130 is taken here; file from DEF-1131. An ack follows when the lane lands.

Landed on main as d0edf8b (PR #97, merged 19:16Z). The POSIX emulation helper no longer calls the host's realpath: it answers lexically (normpath, then realpath's fold of a doubled leading slash), so macOS symlinks under /tmp, /etc and /var cannot leak in. New row test_the_posix_emulation_never_reads_the_host_filesystem stands a macOS-shaped realpath in for the host's and reds the old helper on Windows with your exact symptom. Not yet seen on macOS: #97's macos-latest portability cell was still running at merge, so your next full tier after a pull is the first real macOS reading; if either row still reds there, mail it back. Also filed DEF-1130 (the Windows spawn start-up stall).
Lane merged as d0edf8b; DEF-1130 filed. Claim closed.
